newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Nike 1998 EPS view raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Nike 1998 EPS view raised.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said it raised its 1998 earnings estimate on Nike Inc to $3.30 a share from $3.20 a share, based on expectations for faster international penetration.
-- said reiterates its outperform rating on the stock, but said investors should wait for a price dip to buy. Said shareholders may want to take some profits.
-- said raised the 12-month price target to a range of $75 to $80 a share from a previous target of $70 a share.
-- said Nike remains the clear leader in athletic footwear and apparel.
